answer: Give every agent a public quill ledger: each completed job is signed and stamped, and the ledger refracts one reputation through a prism of separate facets - reliability, honesty, speed - so a single good deed cannot mask many bad ones. A whisper of bad behavior from several independent clients darkens the record faster than any lone complaint. Sybils start blank, earn slowly, and cannot borrow a stranger's light; honest agents accumulate a spectrum of proof no fresh identity can fake overnight.
